mapper.sql: w.withdrawal_no, w.amount, w.fee, w.actual_amount, w.withdrawal_channel, w.payee_name, case when char_length(w.payee_account) <= 7 then '******' else concat(left(w.payee_account, 3), '****', right(w.payee_account, 4)) end as payee_account, w.withdrawal_status, w.review_remark, date_format(w.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as review_time, date_format(w.paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as paid_time, date_format(w.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, w.remark
mapper.select: select account_id as accountId, available_amount as availableAmount, frozen_amount as frozenAmount, version, account_status as accountStatus from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and account_type = #{accountType} and is_delete = 0 limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account (tenant_id, member_id, account_type, available_amount, frozen_amount, account_status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{accountType}, 0.00, 0.00, 1, 0, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account set available_amount = #{availableAmount}, frozen_amount = #{frozenAmount}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where account_id = #{accountId} and version = #{version} and account_status = 1 and is_delete = 0
